column1: # mapping_set_description: 'Maps the 7 minimum-element concepts defined in The Minimum Elements For a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) (NTIA, November 2021) to properties, classes and RelationshipType individuals of the SPDX 3.1-dev model. Revised 2026-10-12: component version -> Core/version (packageVersion deprecated in 3.1), dependency relationship -> Relationship/dependsOn, supplier -> suppliedBy or originatedBy, spdxId as identifier. The see_also column cites the neutral bridge concept from bom.ttl.'

column8: NTIA 'Supplier Name' is the entity that creates, defines and identifies a component; Artifact.suppliedBy (-> Agent) is the supplying party. exactMatch via bom:component-supplier, which the bridge keeps for the NTIA / FSCT / BSI reading; the originator half is carried by originatedBy (next row).

Artifact.originatedBy (-> Agent) covers the originating author of the component, the reading CISA 2026 makes explicit as 'Component Producer'. closeMatch: populate originatedBy when the supplier is the producer, suppliedBy when it is a distributor.
Element.name on a Package (or other Artifact) element carries the component name. Exact match.
SPDX 3.1-dev: Core/version (0..1) exposed on Software/Package carries the component version string (Software/packageVersion is deprecated in 3.1). Exact match.
DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1 (use Core/version); SPDX 3.0.1 field. closeMatch retained for compatibility.
PURL in Software/Package.packageUrl is the recommended globally unique identifier for components in SPDX 3.x. Exact match for the primary external-identifier use case described by NTIA.
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe22 (identifier = the CPE 2.2 string). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe23. closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swid (SWID tag id). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swhid (Software Heritage persistent identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType gitoid (OmniBOR artifact or input-manifest identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
The element's spdxId IRI is globally unique and may serve as an identifier within and across SPDX documents, but does not replace a common external identifier. closeMatch.

An instance of Core/Relationship with relationshipType dependsOn: from = the dependent component, to = its dependencies. NTIA requires relationships to be present for each component (the primary component included); Relationship.completeness states whether the listed dependencies are complete. Exact match for the dependency reading. The model requires a LifecycleScopedRelationship for this type (scope: LifecycleScopeType).
The 'includes' reading of NTIA's upstream relationship: relationshipType contains from the containing package to its subcomponents. closeMatch.
Generic: all dependency relationships are Core/Relationship elements with from, to and relationshipType. closeMatch at class level.
CreationInfo.createdBy (1..*) captures the Agent(s) -- Person, Organization or SoftwareAgent -- that authored the document; the generating tool belongs in createdUsing. Exact match.
CreationInfo.created is a mandatory Core/DateTime (UTC, second resolution) recording when the document was created. Exact match.
